connectiveFloorPlan: The floor is satisfied at slot level by print-ready-export-no-watermark (data_out, proof artifact must contain PdfDocument or ACTION_SEND or FileProvider or ACTION_CREATE_DOCUMENT), with two more connective claims behind it - bring-the-list-the-shop-already-has and the-shops-own-dish-on-the-card (data_in, PickVisualMedia or ACTION_IMAGE_CAPTURE), find-a-list-or-a-price-row (find), list-survives-a-new-phone (durability) and dated-price-refresh-nudge (reminder). Every row starts deferred, so no proof is present yet; each deferredReason names the artifact and the token the row will be proved by.
comparisonsNote: A comparison names the incumbent a promise is a difference from, with the limitation that incumbent carries and where that was read. Its truth is recon's business and a human reads it; no sampled review names DPI, bleed or print colour, and that absence is recorded in the proposal rather than hidden here.

claims.promise: The list the shop already keeps arrives on the phone as editable rows - a CSV or spreadsheet opened through the system picker, a block pasted from a message, or a photograph of the old card - so nothing is retyped from scratch.

evidence.finding: com.zakasoft.pricelist is rated 1.7 stars with 50K+ installs, and 2 of its 3 sampled reviews ask how to use the same entered items and prices on a second phone; com.micrasol.pricelistmaker is 2.3 stars with 50K+ installs and a 1-star review says the entered price amounts are not retained within each product category (scan-complaints.mjs --query 'price card maker', 2026-10-16).

comparison.limitation: Two of its three sampled reviews ask how to get the same entered items and prices onto a second phone; nothing in its sampled criticism describes taking the shop's existing list in at all.

claims.promise: One price list becomes five artefacts in the same look - the menu, the price card, the table tent, the window sign and a story-size post - from a single generated background rather than five separate jobs.

evidence.finding: The price card maker shelf is mixed with 30 cards seen, 14 of 30 rated and 5 weak; its missing-feature class is 3 of 14 critical reviews and its install leader com.oaklagcs.mypricelist (3.6 stars, 500K+ installs) carries 2 missing-feature findings in 2 critical reviews - 'Great concept, but needs some work' and a request to show the product cost on the list page (scan-market.mjs and scan-complaints.mjs, 2026-10-16).

claims.promise: Every price on every artefact is typed data typeset on the device from the shop's own rows, never drawn by an image model, so what the customer reads at the counter is what the owner entered.

evidence.finding: Accuracy is 3 of 14 critical reviews in the price card pocket (21%), including com.micrasol.pricelistmaker's 'the entered price amounts are not being retained within each product category' (2.3 stars, 50K+ installs), and com.pricelistmaker at 4.1 stars with 100K+ installs carries accuracy and paywall findings in 3 critical reviews (scan-complaints.mjs --query 'price card maker', 2026-10-16).

claims.promise: The finished set leaves the phone as a print page at the size the owner chose plus a share image for the shop's own channel - a PDF written with PdfDocument, a FileProvider URI shared through ACTION_SEND, and a save-to-folder path through ACTION_CREATE_DOCUMENT - with no watermark, no subscription and no trial gate in front of it.

evidence.finding: Paywall is 4 of 14 critical reviews (29%) in the price card pocket, and the 1M+ install leader com.menu.maker (4.9 stars) is reviewed 'you can't even save high quality image without paying'; com.pricelistmaker at 100K+ installs is reviewed 'the import/export functionality for Excel files is completely unreliable' (scan-complaints.mjs, 2026-10-16).
